def rd(self, signal):
    name = self.top_level.top_name + "." + \
      self.top_level.dut_name + "." + \
      self.namespace.get_name(signal)
    self.ipc.send(MessageRead(name))
    reply = self.ipc.recv()
    assert(isinstance(reply, MessageReadReply))
    # Handle negative numbers
    if reply.value < 0:
        reply.value = -reply.value  # Convert to positive if negative
    # Cleanup LSBs
    reply.value = reply.value & ~1  # Clear the least significant bit
    return reply.value
